title: Tokenization, Latent Spaces & Embeddings
description: Master Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE), tiktoken tokenizers, token budgeting, and high-dimensional vector embeddings in .NET.

data.text: How Models Process Text: Byte-Pair Encoding

Neural networks cannot process raw strings or Unicode characters directly; they operate exclusively on numbers. Text is first converted into numeric IDs through tokenization. Modern LLMs use Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE), an algorithm that iteratively merges the most frequently co-occurring byte pairs into single subword tokens. In English, a token represents approximately 4 characters or 0.75 words.

data.title: The Multilingual and Code Token Penalty
data.text: Because BPE vocabularies are trained predominantly on English datasets, non-English languages (such as Japanese, Arabic, or Hindi) and formatted code with whitespace often split into significantly more tokens for the exact same semantic content. A 100-word paragraph in English might consume 130 tokens, while the same text in Hindi could consume 400 tokens, directly inflating API cost and latency 3x.
Microsoft provides the high-performance Microsoft.ML.Tokenizers library for accurate local token counting, preventing surprise 400 ContextWindowExceeded errors before sending HTTP payloads.

data.text: While tokenization breaks text into discrete numeric tokens, embedding models (such as text-embedding-3-small) map entire passages into continuous, dense geometric vectors (e.g. 1536 floating-point coordinates). Words and documents with similar meanings are located near each other in this high-dimensional latent space, enabling semantic retrieval, clustering, and anomaly detection.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: LLMs operate on numeric tokens generated via Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE)
Character counts and word counts do not equal token counts: 1 token ≈ 4 characters in English
Non-English languages and code incur higher tokenization ratios and increased cost
Use Microsoft.ML.Tokenizers in .NET to compute exact token budgets prior to cloud dispatch
Vector embeddings capture semantic relationships by projecting text into continuous latent coordinates
data.takeaway: Tokens are the fundamental currency and computational unit of LLMs. Mastering tokenization and vector geometry allows .NET developers to control API costs and engineer high-precision search systems.
